rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$18.3k cash deficit by abolishing the stagnant 82% shed hoarding bottleneck in favor of continuous capital-velocity liquidations (at 25% shed occupancy or 6+ units at >=0.85x base), unlocking fluid cash to finance 100% hyper-fertilized recurring Strawberry cultivation following a 48-hour Carrot bootstrap. It extends Town Shop contract execution through step 710 while strictly locking only exact active-quota items to prevent surplus inventory freeze, and bounds contiguous land expansion to 12-14 plots prior to Day 16 when workforce reaches >= 8 hands. Finally, it transforms farm dispatch with cluster harvesting and priority watering above shed transit, reclaiming over 50% of wasted worker steps to maximize multi-harvest yield compounding.
